description: Immutable baseline snapshot of the PARTIAL-data curriculum (Version A). Frozen at 625/842 games. Used as the experimental control for the A/B comparison against the full-842 curriculum (Version B).

snapshot_context.note: mistakes.jsonl is a 500-entry rolling window; mistakes_queued_at_snapshot is the durable job counter.

integrity_rule: compare_curriculum.py verifies the on-disk baseline file SHA-256 against this manifest before reporting. A mismatch means the baseline was modified and the comparison is invalid.
